name: RETROKILL (DEMO)
desc:
CONTROLS :
Shift - Dash
Ctrl - Slide / Downslam
F - Punch / Parry
R - Grapple
G - Heavy Punch (or Hold to EXPLODE) (also shares cooldown with Punch)

WEAPON KEYBINDS:
LMB - Normal Fire
RMB - Alternate Fire (Applies to some weapons)
(KEYBINDS CAN BE MODIFIED IN SETTINGS)

-------------------------------------------

REMARKS : 
- This game is PC-Only!! It has NO CONSOLE SUPPORT!
- Multiplayer is VERY UNPOLISHED
- This game requires a good internet connection to run smoothly! if your experience is janky, please play in a private server!!
- This is my first project and mostly solo dev, expect bugs!
- HEAVILY INSPIRED BY ULTRAKILL (by Hakita)
